summary: Verified Vercel build-config bug fix. .npmrc and vercel.json are deleted. package.json has react-day-picker ^9.5.0 and date-fns 3.6.0. npm install --dry-run in /tmp/verify exits 0 with NO ERESOLVE errors and NO --legacy-peer-deps flag. yarn install --frozen-lockfile succeeds. yarn build succeeds producing build/index.html + static/js/main.f5965428.js with no compile errors. Runtime regression: Dashboard loads with kpi-total = 14 (real live data), Students page shows Simran Ahuja + 13 others from live Google Apps Script sheet. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/components/ui/calendar.jsx still uses react-day-picker v8 classNames API (IconLeft/IconRight, classNames props like day_selected). Not imported anywhere so no runtime impact currently, but if used in future it will render incorrectly. Consider migrating to v9 API or removing the file.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Build-config fix verified. Vercel deployment should now succeed without any peer-dep workarounds.
rca of the issue: react-day-picker@8 required react ^16||^17||^18 but project uses react@19. Fix: bump to react-day-picker ^9.5.0 (supports React 19 + date-fns v4) and pin date-fns to 3.6.0.
